decisions.statement: A passage is answered as a splice so one body's passages land together.
The slug a property's page states is answered as the text under the key named.
A body stating no text under that key is refused.
A body already stating the slug asked for is refused.
The key respelled sits in the exported object itself where no holding key is named.
A holding key named respells the key in each record that key states.
A record stating no such key is passed over.
A body already stating the key asked for is refused.
A body exporting no object is refused.
A key spelled as a string is respelled as a string.
Every entry of a run of entries stating that key has the key respelled.
An entry stating no such key is passed over rather than refused.
One passage is answered however many entries are respelled.
A key inside a value an entry states is left as that key is.
A body that is no run of entries is refused.
Nothing here reads the disk or an index.
Nothing here reads which pages carry the property.

definition: the passages in one body where a page property's key or its slug is spelled anew
